title: Jelly Field 2D!
description: A game in an unusual setting! Compete with friends and colleagues! In the game you have a game zone where you need to throw cubes and if they have the same color, then they connect! Connect as many colors as possible to complete the level, accumulate points! Become the first on the leaderboard! Play and relax!
instructions: 1 At first it will be easy to connect the cubes but over time the levels will become more difficult Complete all levels
